title: Monthly Yellow Taxi Revenue Summary Contract

revenue_definition.formula: SUM(total_amount) WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= month_start AND tpep_pickup_datetime < month_end AND total_amount > 0 AND fare_amount >= 0
revenue_definition.itemized_reconciliation_formula: COALESCE(fare_amount,0) + COALESCE(extra,0) + COALESCE(mta_tax,0) + COALESCE(tip_amount,0) + COALESCE(tolls_amount,0) + COALESCE(improvement_surcharge,0) + COALESCE(congestion_surcharge,0) + COALESCE(airport_fee,0) [+ COALESCE(cbd_congestion_fee,0)]
revenue_definition.reversal_handling: Trips with total_amount <= 0 or fare_amount < 0 (vendor dispute/void reversal adjustments) are segregated into reversal_adjustments_usd and excluded from gross_passenger_revenue_usd so negative reversal rows never silently depress positive recognized revenue or distort unit economics.
revenue_definition.temporal_rule: Strictly bounded to tpep_pickup_datetime within [YYYY-MM-01 00:00:00, next_month-01 00:00:00). Taximeter clock-drift spillover records outside the target month must be excluded.
